title: Free RFID & NFC Sample Pack — Cards, Tags, Labels, Wristbands, Keyfobs
summary: Hold the chip in your hand before you spec a programme. Proud Tek ships a free RFID & NFC sample pack to qualified B2B buyers — typically 8–12 SKUs covering 125 kHz LF (EM4100, T5577), 13.56 MHz HF (MIFARE Classic 1K, MIFARE DESFire EV3, NTAG215, NTAG424 DNA, ICODE SLIX2) and UHF RAIN ({chip:impinj-monza-r6-p:name}, {chip:nxp-ucode-9:name}, {chip:alien-higgs-9:name}). Tell us your project below in 5 fields or less and a Proud Tek specialist will follow up within one business day with shipping and pre-encoding options.

sections.title: Why hold the chip before you spec a programme
sections.intro: A datasheet number tells you the antenna read range at the bench-test condition. The chip in your hand tells you the real-world fit — does the credential survive folding in a pocket, does the inlay read through the substrate you actually use, does the keyfob clip onto your existing badge holder. The procurement teams that move fastest are the ones that get samples on the bench in week 1.
bullets: Antenna read range on your real substrate (laminate thickness, label adhesive, ABS / PVC / PPS housing).
Form-factor ergonomics on your real reader (front desk encoder height, gate-portal antenna geometry, handheld scanner trigger).
Survivability on your real environment (hot wash, ozone, chemical sterilization, mechanical agitation).
Chip-protocol fit on your real software (lock platform, WMS, POS, access-control panel).
End-user reaction on your real workflow (front-desk encoding time, sort-line throughput, attendee gate experience).

sections.title: What happens after you submit the form
sections.intro: One human reply, one shipment, one follow-up — that is the entire flow.
bullets: Within one business day — a Proud Tek specialist replies by email to confirm the sample pack contents match your brief. If your project skews to a specific chip family we add or swap samples accordingly.
Day 1–2 — pack assembled, packaging label printed.
Day 2 — handed to DHL or FedEx. You receive the tracking number by email.
Day 5–10 — pack arrives at your destination address.
Week 2 — your Proud Tek specialist sends a one-line follow-up offering a short technical call to walk through chip and form-factor choices. No automated drip-marketing cadence.

sections.title: Pre-encoded samples (optional)
sections.intro: Want the chip to arrive with your encoding already written? Tell us in the project-notes field.
bullets: MIFARE Classic 1K — sector keys + sector data pre-written to your specification.
MIFARE DESFire EV3 — application + file structure created, AID + master key set per your brief.
NTAG21x — NDEF record (URL, vCard, text) pre-written.
NTAG424 DNA — SDM (Secure Dynamic Messaging) cryptographic profile configured.
UHF RAIN — GS1 SGTIN-96 EPC written to your prefix + serial range.
ICODE SLIX2 — AFI byte + library catalogue ID pre-written.

faq.question: Is the sample pack genuinely free?
faq.answer: Yes — the sample pack content is free. The buyer covers DHL / FedEx shipping (typically $25–60 depending on destination). We do not bundle shipping into the sample price because shipping rates vary so widely by region; transparent shipping cost is fairer than rolled-in shipping cost. Once we receive your form submission we email a shipping quote alongside the pack confirmation.

faq.question: Why a 5-field form? Other manufacturers ask for 10 or 15 fields.
faq.answer: Because the only information we actually need to ship the right pack is your name (so we know who to address the email to), your email (so we can reply), your country (so we can quote shipping), your target quantity (so we know what production tier to brief the pack against) and your project notes (so we can swap chips into the pack to match your application). Everything else — company size, job title, budget range, decision timeline — is qualifying-quiz friction that procurement teams correctly resent.

faq.question: Can I request specific chips that are not in the standard pack?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the project-notes field to specify chip families (HITAG 2, FeliCa, LEGIC advant, EM4305, NTAG216, NXP ICODE DNA, Impinj M730, EM4423 dual-frequency, etc.) and form factors (silicone wristband, ceramic anti-metal, PPS laundry tag, on-metal UHF sticker). We add up to three custom chip / form-factor combinations to a sample pack at no incremental cost.

faq.question: Does the sample pack include a written specification sheet?
faq.answer: Yes — every pack ships with a 2-page printed specification card listing the chip family, the chip part number, the antenna size, the form-factor dimensions, the operating temperature range, the read-range datasheet number and the Proud Tek SKU for each sample. The same sheet is also emailed as a PDF on dispatch.

faq.question: What if I need to evaluate samples under NDA?
faq.answer: We sign mutual NDAs at the project-brief stage — common for healthcare, defense, luxury-brand authentication and pharmaceutical buyers. The sample pack itself is generic production-grade SKU, but the encoding (if pre-encoded) and the project-brief conversation are covered under NDA. Send a short email request to info@proudtek.com after submitting the form and we will return a signature-ready NDA template within one business day.

faq.question: How does this differ from buying a 100-piece evaluation batch?
faq.answer: The free sample pack is for chip-family and form-factor validation — 8–12 SKUs, mixed chip families, mixed form factors. An evaluation batch is the next step: 100–500 pieces of a single chip and form factor in a generic SKU (no custom artwork) so you can run a real software / encoding / reader-platform integration test. Evaluation batches ship at standard FOB Shenzhen pricing and typically land in 7–14 days.
